zh: 本页保留 R0.61 到 R0.73Q 的全部 133 个节点。R0.61–R0.69W 从约化递推走到严格环带排除；R0.70A–R0.71Z 检查移动尺度、临界账本、内部 entry 与 complete-root 边界；R0.72A–R0.73B 处理 strong coupling、critical log、碰撞几何与完整线性 Fourier--Leray 行；R0.73C–I 依次处理冻结 Rayleigh 不稳定、黏性谱簇持续、固定正半平面传递、移动剖面增益、非线性相对放大、平面固定距离偏离与零窗口作用量边界。R0.73J 认证无黏连续谱支，R0.73K 闭合参数一致的黏性 rank-one 谱支，R0.73L 把冻结谱支升级为真实非自治 selected action；R0.73M 再用完整 action 指定种子，并在固定物理时刻闭合二维非线性固定距离偏离。背景随 \(\Lambda\) 改变，轨道留在精确二维不变子空间；prefactor 极限、两项 WKB、固定背景、横向三维、奇性与 Clay 没有被外推。 R0.73M 证明：当 \(\Lambda\to\infty\) 且背景随之改变时，按完整作用量 缩小的平面扰动可以在固定时刻保持固定阶输出。R0.73N 补上固定成员审计： 任意共存强解满足有限累积应变控制；平面扰动全局满足 \(L^2\) 稳定估计； 足够小的全三维 \(H^3\) 扰动落在正的全局强解稳定管内。因此，R0.73M 中的量词顺序不能交换为一个固定背景上的任意小输入、固定距离逃逸。 R0.73O 关闭了已知全局无强迫背景上的 \(H^3\)-小扰动不稳定路线：每条轨道最终衰减，累积 \(H^4\) 作用量有限，并有一个对所有起始时刻有效的正稳定半径。强迫对照保留无限累积应变，并由平面方向给出全局光滑、初始 \(H^3\) 趋零而输出固定 \(L^2\) 逃逸的见证。 R0.73P 关闭了固定全局强轨道周围的临界稳定与带限输入接口：临界管对所有起始时刻有效，\(N^{-1/2}\) 指数对范数转移精确，并允许 \(L^2\) 趋零而 \(H^3\) 发散的光滑扰动。能量球内所有弱分支在共同延迟后正则并相对参考轨道同步；不能跨越的部分是此前的早期弱区间。 这一节用周期 Stokes--HLS 双线性估计和有限 Volterra 递推，构造了一个全起点统一的临界热流稳定管。精确 Fourier 族证明它加入了旧 \(H^{1/2}\) 管之外的光滑安全数据；裸 Kato 上确界则被一个时间端点反例阻断。whole-space Besov 开放性属于已知文献，Clay 结论仍开放。
en: This page retains all nodes from R0.61 through R0.73Q, 133 in total. R0.61–R0.69W moves from reduced recurrences to rigorous annular exclusion; R0.70A–R0.71Z examines moving scales, the critical ledger, internal entry, and the complete-root boundary; R0.72A–R0.73B treats strong coupling, the critical log, collision geometry, and the complete linear Fourier--Leray row; R0.73C–I successively treats frozen Rayleigh instability, persistence of viscous spectral clusters, transfer to a fixed positive half-plane, moving-profile gain, nonlinear relative amplification, fixed-distance planar departure, and the zero-window action boundary. R0.73J certifies the inviscid spectral branch of the continuum operator; R0.73K closes the parameter-uniform viscous rank-one spectral branch; and R0.73L upgrades the frozen spectral branch to a genuine nonautonomous selected action. R0.73M then specifies the seed through the full action and closes two-dimensional nonlinear fixed-distance departure at a fixed physical time. The background varies with \(\Lambda\), while the orbit stays in the exact two-dimensional invariant subspace; the prefactor limit, two-term WKB, a fixed background, transverse three-dimensional effects, singularity, and Clay are not extrapolated. R0.73M proves that, as \(\Lambda\to\infty\) with the background varying accordingly, planar perturbations scaled down by the full action can retain fixed-order output at a fixed time. R0.73N adds the fixed-member audit: every coexisting strong solution obeys finite accumulated-strain control; planar perturbations satisfy a global \(L^2\) stability estimate; and sufficiently small fully three-dimensional \(H^3\) perturbations lie in a positive global strong-solution stability tube. Hence the quantifier order in R0.73M cannot be exchanged for arbitrarily small inputs escaping to a fixed distance on one fixed background. R0.73O closes the \(H^3\)-small perturbation instability route around known global unforced backgrounds: every orbit eventually decays, has finite accumulated \(H^4\) action, and possesses a positive stability radius valid at every initial time. The forced comparison retains infinite accumulated strain and supplies a globally smooth planar witness whose initial \(H^3\) norm tends to zero while its output escapes by a fixed \(L^2\) distance. R0.73P closes the critical stability and band-limited input interfaces around a fixed global strong orbit: the critical tube is valid at every initial time, the \(N^{-1/2}\) exponent is exact for norm transfer, and smooth perturbations may tend to zero in \(L^2\) while diverging in \(H^3\). Every weak branch in the energy ball becomes regular after a common delay and synchronizes relative to the reference orbit; the uncrossed part is the preceding early weak interval. This section uses a periodic Stokes--HLS bilinear estimate and finite Volterra recursion to construct a critical heat-flow stability tube uniform over all starting times. An exact Fourier family proves that it adds smooth safe data outside the old \(H^{1/2}\) tube; a time-endpoint counterexample blocks the bare Kato supremum. Whole-space Besov openness belongs to the established literature, and the Clay conclusion remains open.

zh: 固定一条先验全局强轨道后，初始差不必在 \(H^{1/2}\) 中很小；只要它的线性热流属于一个足够小的 \(L^4_tL^6_x\) 球，非线性交叉项就能通过有限时间分段闭合，并得到对所有重启时刻统一的全局 \(H^3\) 稳定半径。
en: After fixing an a priori global strong orbit, the initial difference need not be small in \(H^{1/2}\); provided that its linear heat flow lies in a sufficiently small \(L^4_tL^6_x\) ball, partitioning time into finitely many intervals allows the nonlinear cross-term estimate to close and yields a global \(H^3\) stability radius uniform over all restart times.

zh: 这一节用周期 Stokes--HLS 双线性估计和有限 Volterra 递推，构造了一个全起点统一的临界热流稳定管。精确 Fourier 族证明它加入了旧 \(H^{1/2}\) 管之外的光滑安全数据；裸 Kato 上确界则被一个时间端点反例阻断。whole-space Besov 开放性属于已知文献，Clay 结论仍开放。
en: This section uses a periodic Stokes--HLS bilinear estimate and finite Volterra recursion to construct a critical heat-flow stability tube uniform over all starting times. An exact Fourier family proves that it adds smooth safe data outside the old \(H^{1/2}\) tube; a time-endpoint counterexample blocks the bare Kato supremum. Whole-space Besov openness belongs to the established literature, and the Clay conclusion remains open.

zh: 这一节用周期 Stokes--HLS 双线性估计和有限 Volterra 递推，构造了一个全起点统一的临界热流稳定管。精确 Fourier 族证明它加入了旧 \(H^{1/2}\) 管之外的光滑安全数据；裸 Kato 上确界则被一个时间端点反例阻断。whole-space Besov 开放性属于已知文献，Clay 结论仍开放。 任意 L2-only 入口、奇性与 Clay 保持 OPEN。
en: This section uses a periodic Stokes--HLS bilinear estimate and finite Volterra recursion to construct a critical heat-flow stability tube uniform over all starting times. An exact Fourier family proves that it adds smooth safe data outside the old \(H^{1/2}\) tube; a time-endpoint counterexample blocks the bare Kato supremum. Whole-space Besov openness belongs to the established literature, and the Clay conclusion remains open. The arbitrary L2-only entrance, singularities, and Clay remain OPEN.

zh: 这一节用周期 Stokes--HLS 双线性估计和有限 Volterra 递推，构造了一个全起点统一的临界热流稳定管。精确 Fourier 族证明它加入了旧 \(H^{1/2}\) 管之外的光滑安全数据；裸 Kato 上确界则被一个时间端点反例阻断。whole-space Besov 开放性属于已知文献，Clay 结论仍开放。 下一关是 R0.73R：R0.73R 将把单一频率上界升级为热扩散集中度证书：逐壳层追踪模态数量、相位相干和 \(L^6/L^2\) 集中，寻找可计算的 \(\mathfrak X\)-入口，并明确它与一般 \(L^2\)-only 问题之间还差什么。
en: This section uses a periodic Stokes--HLS bilinear estimate and finite Volterra recursion to construct a critical heat-flow stability tube uniform over all starting times. An exact Fourier family proves that it adds smooth safe data outside the old \(H^{1/2}\) tube; a time-endpoint counterexample blocks the bare Kato supremum. Whole-space Besov openness belongs to the established literature, and the Clay conclusion remains open. The next gate is R0.73R: R0.73R will upgrade a single-frequency upper bound to a heat-diffusion concentration certificate by tracking modal counts, phase coherence, and \(L^6/L^2\) concentration shell by shell, seeking a computable \(\mathfrak X\) entrance, and stating precisely what still separates it from the general \(L^2\)-only problem.

zh: R0.73Q 增加了一个周期 \(\dot B^{-1/2}_{6,4}\) 热流入口。显式剪切模可以同时满足 \(L^2\to0\)、热流迹 \(\to0\)，却有 \(H^{1/2}\to\infty\)；因此新旧稳定管的并集严格扩大。任意 \(L^2\)-小数据仍未覆盖。
en: R0.73Q adds a periodic \(\dot B^{-1/2}_{6,4}\) heat-flow entrance. Explicit shear modes can satisfy \(L^2\to0\) and heat-flow trace \(\to0\), yet \(H^{1/2}\to\infty\); the union of the new and old stability tubes is therefore strictly larger. Arbitrary \(L^2\)-small data remain uncovered.
